description: Locked subject-disjoint held-out test split for the utility-of-synthetic-dorsal-hands study. The split is balanced to 15 subjects per age bin; synthetic data must never be used for validation or test.

selection_method.primary_sources: Within each age bin, handRGBD and Archive are split as evenly as availability allows.
selection_method.fallback_sources: 11k Hands (primary) and ProlificHands are used only when handRGBD + Archive cannot fill the 15-subject age-bin target.
